description: bear shake: both claws up from the first beat to the last, a new shape every half second (up in a V, crossed in front, out flat, both swung to one side), while the four back legs step sideways one at a time, each lifted 30 mm, the body swaying fore and aft to keep its weight over the three feet down, 175 mm to the left and back, crouched, the body bobbing and shuddering at 5 Hz; ends in a W
